subItems.name: Fruit & Vegetable Peels
subItems.prep: Chop into smaller pieces to accelerate microbial aerobic breakdown.
subItems.upcycling: Make citrus bio-enzymes for non-toxic home cleaning spray.

subItems.name: Cooked Leftover Food
subItems.prep: Drain excess curry/oil; dispose in home compost bin or municipal wet bin.
subItems.upcycling: Can be converted into nutrient-rich vermicompost or animal fodder if fresh.

subItems.name: Coffee Grounds & Tea Leaves
subItems.prep: Rinse out milk/sugar if possible; sprinkle directly on garden soil as nitrogen booster.
subItems.upcycling: Excellent organic fertilizer for roses and acid-loving plants.

subItems.name: Eggshells
subItems.prep: Rinse and crush coarsely before adding to compost.
subItems.upcycling: Rich in calcium carbonate; helps balance compost acidity and deters garden pests.

subItems.name: PET Beverage Bottles (Type 1)
subItems.prep: Empty, rinse out residues, flatten completely to save volume, replace cap.
subItems.upcycling: Transform into hanging self-watering herb pots or bird feeders.

subItems.name: HDPE Milk Jugs & Detergent Bottles (Type 2)
subItems.prep: Rinse thoroughly to remove detergent surfactants; place in blue recycling bin.
subItems.upcycling: Heavy-duty plastic can be converted into garage tool containers.

subItems.name: PP Food Containers (Type 5)
subItems.prep: Wash off oil and food stains; grease contamination degrades recycling batch purity.
subItems.upcycling: Reusable for hardware storage (screws, nails, craft supplies).

subItems.name: Single-Use LDPE Plastic Bags
subItems.prep: Bundle clean, dry bags together inside one bag before recycling.
subItems.upcycling: Fuse with parchment paper and an iron into waterproof sturdy craft fabric.

subItems.name: Corrugated Shipping Boxes
subItems.prep: Remove plastic packing tape, flatten completely, keep dry.
subItems.upcycling: Cut into drawer dividers or use as weed barrier sheet in garden beds.

subItems.name: Office Paper & Notebooks
subItems.prep: Remove metal spiral bindings and plastic covers.
subItems.upcycling: Use blank reverse sides for scratch notes or shred for compost carbon layer.

subItems.name: Newspapers & Magazines
subItems.prep: Bundle securely with natural jute twine; avoid wetting.
subItems.upcycling: Use for streak-free window cleaning or wrapping fragile glassware.

subItems.name: Aluminum Beverage Cans
subItems.prep: Rinse, crush flat, deposit into metal/dry recycling.
subItems.upcycling: Can be melted down and remanufactured into new cans in just 60 days.

subItems.name: Tin Food Cans
subItems.prep: Rinse clean, push lid inside so sharp edges do not injure sanitation workers.
subItems.upcycling: Punch small holes in pattern to create rustic candle luminaries or pen stands.

subItems.name: Scrap Iron & Hardware
subItems.prep: Keep separate from domestic trash; sell to local scrap buy-back center.
subItems.upcycling: High monetary trade-in value at certified scrap merchants.

subItems.name: Clear Glass Bottles & Jars
subItems.prep: Rinse residue, remove metal lids, handle carefully to avoid shattering.
subItems.upcycling: Sterilize and reuse for kitchen spice storage, jams, or propagation vases.

subItems.name: Colored Glass Bottles (Amber/Green)
subItems.prep: Segregate by color if local collection center requires color-sorting.
subItems.upcycling: Turn into decorative garden border lanterns or candle holders.

subItems.name: Smartphones & Tablets
subItems.prep: Backup data, perform factory reset, do not puncture battery, deposit at e-waste center.
subItems.upcycling: Old phones can be converted into home security IP cameras or smart alarm clocks.

subItems.name: Cables, Chargers & Adapters
subItems.prep: Bundle with a velcro tie; never burn for copper recovery (toxic dioxin hazard).
subItems.upcycling: Trade in at authorized electronics buyback or take-back kiosks.

subItems.name: Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs)
subItems.prep: Store in dry static-free box; surrender to authorized smelters.
subItems.upcycling: 1 metric ton of PCBs contains 40-800x more gold than 1 ton of mined gold ore.

categories.name: Hazardous & Sanitary Waste
categories.primaryAction: High-Temp Incineration / Hazardous Waste Secure Landfill (HWL)
categories.warning: DO NOT mix with standard trash. Toxic risk to groundwater and waste handlers.

subItems.name: Household Dry Cell & Lithium Batteries
subItems.prep: Tape both battery terminals with clear scotch tape to prevent short circuits.
subItems.upcycling: Drop in designated battery collection kiosks found in electronics stores.

subItems.name: Expired Medications & Syringes
subItems.prep: Keep in original packaging; return to pharmacy take-back drop boxes. Syringes in rigid sharps bin.
subItems.upcycling: Never flush down toilet or sink to prevent antibiotic resistance and aquatic toxicity.

subItems.name: Paint Cans & Solvents
subItems.prep: Allow small residual paint to dry out completely before disposal; deposit liquid cans at hazmat day.
subItems.upcycling: Donate leftover half-full paint cans to local community theater or school projects.

subItems.name: Fluorescent Bulbs & CFLs
subItems.prep: Wrap carefully in bubble wrap/paper to prevent mercury vapor release if shattered.
subItems.upcycling: Take to municipal hazardous collection; mercury is reclaimed under vacuum distillation.
